item.title: Splat 1.0.10
item.description:
- **A sidebar button** beside the window's title shows and hides the sidebar on the tab it showed last. New windows and the next launch open it as it was left. - Showing or hiding the sidebar keeps source and preview at their share of the window. - **Code** has a shortcut, ⌥⇧⌘C, and moved into the code block menu of the toolbar, so the whole toolbar fits a new window. - The **word count** in the corner now starts hidden; **View › Show Word Count** turns it on. - **About Splat** shows the version once, with the copyright and the license.
Something wrong or missing? [Report it on GitHub](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat/issues/new/choose).
